tools.name: fv_get_sample_scene
tools.description: Opens one of Field-Viewer's three synthetic sample models (e.g. woning_lindehof) read-only: signed 3D artefact URLs valid for 24 h, plus its name and audience. Use listSamples for the slugs. Public, no side effects.

tools.name: fv_get_service_status
tools.description: Reports whether the Field-Viewer API is reachable and which build is serving traffic. Use it as a first, unauthenticated call to confirm the API is up, or to read the current buildId for support and debugging. Do not use it to check a specific resource's health or as a substitute for authentication.

tools.name: fv_list_plans
tools.description: Lists Field-Viewer's plans (free, team, enterprise) with their limits, features and the Team price (EUR cents, excl. VAT, monthly and yearly), the Team trial length (trial.days, no card) and grace days after a failed payment (graceDays): what each plan allows and costs, whether it takes DXF/DWG draw

tools.name: fv_list_samples
tools.description: Lists Field-Viewer's sample models (slug, name, audience line, card image) that getSampleScene opens. Public, no side effects.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "fv_get_service_status" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
